ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If all the grass died, what would be most affected?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. In the lower left corner there is a node “Grass”, and from near Grass there are arrows pointing to other organisms, among which one arrow pointing to “Grasshopper” can be clearly seen. Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate the relationship from food source to eater. If all the grass died, the organisms that directly depend on grass as food would be affected first and most obviously. In the diagram, Grass points directly to Grasshopper, indicating that grasshoppers depend on grass. Therefore, the most affected are grasshoppers.
